rationale: Points the editor's GABE download button at godotengine.org/download/android#gabe. Upstream Godot branding/URL that is irrelevant to a clean-break Foundry fork.

Fixes infinite recursion in the Java interface-proxy equals()/hashCode() handler. Depends on the interface-proxy feature added by #115498 (a490), which is not in base 4.6.3; also lands in the fully rebranded games.cafecito.foundry Kotlin tree and is not build-verified on macOS.
Guards a null args array (args ?: emptyArray()) in the interface-proxy invocation. Depends on the #115498 proxy feature absent from base; rebranded Kotlin, no android build coverage here.
Adds a taskAffinity manifest entry and a hasExtra guard in command-line arg parsing. Lands in the rebranded Godot.kt/manifest; low value and android-only, not build-verified.

Adds JNISingleton::_get so plugin signals resolve as Signal properties. Part of the 4.7 android plugin-signal rework; base 4.6.3 may not carry the underlying regression, so verify the bug exists before porting. Pairs with #119233/#117682.
Removes the 'Use Gradle Build is experimental' warning label. A product/UX decision for upstream; touches rebranded GodotNativeBridge.kt/strings and carries no functional value for the fork.

Switches JNISingleton signals to add_user_signal and restores early plugin registration. Entangled with the 4.7 android signal-registration cluster (#117682/#119428) and the rebranded Godot.kt; port the cluster together after confirming the base regression.
Reverts the android editor minSdk bump back to 24 (gradle/manifest/editor Kotlin). Config-only, pairs with #118942, android build not exercised here.

Uses DEFAULT_MIN_SDK_VERSION (24) for the compatibility renderer instead of the Vulkan minimum. Missing from base, but the fork's export_plugin.cpp is heavily diverged (~162 lines trimmed) and android export is not build-verified.

Clamps embedded-window min size and avoids divide-by-zero on aspect lock. Depends on the resize feature from #118417 (references MIN_WINDOW_SIZE/resizingEnabled/isFreeResize) which is not in base; rebranded editor-embed Kotlin.
Adds move/resize of the embedded game window (large android-editor UI: layouts, drawables, EmbeddedGodotGame rework). Feature, android-editor-only value, rebranded tree, not build-verified.

Removes deprecated Google Play OBB/expansion/licensing support (54 files, ~9k deletions). Base 4.6.3 still ships OBB, so it is a genuine large removal; reasonable dead-code cleanup for the fork but spans the rebranded android tree and is not build-verified.
Enables perfetto by default for android debug builds (SCsub, detect.py, install script, CMake). Android-debug profiling build tooling with little value for the fork.
Adds export options to customize the android splash screen. Feature touching the diverged export_plugin.cpp plus new assets; android export not build-verified.

Splits Godot.kt into a GodotNativeBridge (moves ~400 lines, touches java_godot_lib_jni/java_godot_wrapper). Large refactor over the tree the fork already rebranded to java_foundry_*; high mechanical rework, not build-verified.

Adds a cmdline-mode error explaining ETC2/ASTC compression is required for android export. Genuinely missing from base and small, but lands inside the fork's heavily trimmed export_plugin.cpp and cannot be build-verified; low-risk nice-to-have once placement is confirmed.
Fixes back-navigation handling when targeting API level 36. Android runtime behavior plus instrumented tests in the rebranded Kotlin tree; not build-verified.

Lets scripts implement Java interfaces via JavaClassWrapper (C++ java_class_wrapper + AndroidRuntimePlugin). Feature (unblocks #119601/#119634); gd test assets are N/A to Foundry Script, and android side is not build-verified.
Follow-up fixes to script-editor orientation change (title-bar toggle JNI). Android-editor-only, depends on #117109, touches editor JNI + rebranded Kotlin.
One-line plugin signal registration fix in Godot.kt, later reworked by #119233. Part of the android plugin-signal cluster; rebranded Kotlin, port the cluster together.
Bumps minimum API/hardware for Vulkan support (export_plugin + gradle/manifest + Godot.kt). Config/policy change; android not build-verified.
java.util.HashMap entrySet-iterator handling in jni_utils.cpp. Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported) and in the fork; nothing to port.
Adds haptic feedback on long-press right-click in the android editor, plus a new EditorSettings entry. Adds a shared editor setting for an android-only behavior; low value, not build-verified.
Adds picture-in-picture: new public DisplayServer virtuals/enum and MainLoop/Node PIP notifications, implemented only on android. Broad new public API surface for android-only value; port-later.
Fixes a FileAccess crash with treeUri in Gradle-built apps via gradle dependency/config changes only. Build-config change, not verifiable in this macOS build.

Enables orientation change in the android Script Editor; adds a distraction_free_mode_changed signal to editor_node.cpp. editor_node.cpp is heavily fork-diverged (multi-scene workspace), conflict risk, android-only value.
Adds support for android plugin gradle platform dependencies (app/build.gradle). Build-config feature, not build-verified.

Only polls for devices when a runnable export preset is configured. Base already carries a related has_runnable_preset implementation but not this _start/_stop refactor, so it is a divergent partial; reconcile before porting.
Removes the sdk>=29 version gate on FEATURE_NATIVE_DIALOG_FILE. Already applied in base 4.6.3 (backported); nothing to port.
Guards _check_for_changes against a null EditorSettings singleton. Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported).
Copies the keystore to a temp file during export (_copy_keystore_to_temp). Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported).
Implements project.godot file associations for the android editor. Foundry uses project.foundry, not project.godot, so the feature as written is inapplicable to the fork.
Fixes OpenXR with Vulkan on android (display_server_android + java_godot_lib_jni). XR-specific, rebranded JNI tree, not build-verified.
JavaClassWrapper PushLocalFrame ExceptionCheck fix for API<=26 crashes. Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported).
Deprecates the Android Studio 'dev' buildtype (gradle). Upstream build tooling with no engine impact for the fork.
Fixes 'Bad file descriptor' by closing ParcelFileDescriptor in SAF/MediaStore data. Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported).
Adjusts an android instrumented file-access .gd test for older devices. Instrumented-test-only fixture, not part of Foundry's test infra.
Makes android instrumented tests fail when a test function does not complete (.gd assets). Instrumented-test harness only, N/A to the fork.
Fixes an || -> && logic bug in CharSequence-array type checking. Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported).

Annual android version bump for 2026 (NDK, config.gradle). Upstream version churn. Note: the bundled text_server_adv.h change narrowing a clang-21 -Wunnecessary-virtual-specifier guard to MINGW32 is separable and subtly affects macOS clang 21+ builds; evaluate independently if needed.
Null-safe context.obbDir?.canonicalPath in StorageScope.kt. Already present in base 4.6.3 (backported).
Adds an orientation_changed signal to DisplayServer, wired on android and apple_embedded. Small and mostly build-verifiable, but a new public-API feature (not a bugfix) with low value for the fork.

Adds Vulkan->OpenGL3 fallback on android by threading a RenderingSource through OS::set_current_rendering_driver_name/method, changing signatures at every platform display-server call site and reworking main.cpp. Broad cross-platform signature change; high ripple for android-only value.
